## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the intended audience of a creative work (the [dcterms:audience](http://purl.org/dc/terms/audience) bridge — a class of readers, a target reader group modelled as an [`Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid using it for the projection consumer of the data (that is [`gmeow:eligibleForConsumer`](gmeow-eligibleForConsumer.md) / [`gmeow:useForConsumer`](gmeow-useForConsumer.md)) — the audience is part of the work's meaning, not a disclosure-control target.

### How to use

- Point the work at the [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) representing the intended audience; keep disclosure-control audiences on the orthogonal consumer axis.

- ex:primer [`gmeow:audience`](gmeow-audience.md) ex:earlyReaders.
